interpretation.root_cause: The runner issued stock baseline SET_ENERGY_CTRL (0xb2) then GET_ENERGY_CTRL (0xb3), but read only after the GET. Static 4/4 preserved-branch analysis shows the 0xb2 handler converges on the same stock one-byte wrapped-response sender used by 0xb3. The queued 0xb2 response was therefore consumed as the first frame after the 0xb3 request and rejected by the runner's B3-only classifier.
interpretation.stock_b2_response_path: 0x126bc setter -> branch to shared one-byte response path at 0x126dc -> call 0xe724
interpretation.stock_b3_response_path: 0x126cc getter -> one-byte response path at 0x126dc -> call 0xe724
interpretation.successor_requirement: Consume and validate each characterized stock response immediately after its producing command; never allow a prior response to remain queued for a later typed B3 discriminator.
